intent: Transition from a low, asymmetric action-idle stance into a neutral upright standing idle.

phases.label: primary rise with rightward pelvis shift and turn

weightTransfer: Pelvis/COM proxy shifts rearward and right early while dipping, then travels forward and toward center as it rises into standing. Support foot is not asserted.
bodyMechanics: Arms and spine begin the unwind first around f2–f3, followed by left-leg extension around f8–f10, right-thigh adjustment at f14, late chest/shoulder alignment around f20–f21, then right lower-leg and root-turn completion at f23.

recommended: combat/ready stance disengage into neutral standing
